# GeoIP2-City-Test.mmdb

A small test database from MaxMind's `MaxMind-DB` repository
(`test-data/GeoIP2-City-Test.mmdb`, https://github.com/maxmind/MaxMind-DB),
copyright MaxMind, Inc., licensed under the Apache License 2.0 or the MIT
License at your option. Used only by the unit and e2e tests of
portal-traffic-visitors-and-geo; it maps a handful of documented addresses
(`81.2.69.160` to GB/ENG, `89.160.20.128` to SE/E, `216.160.83.56` to US/WA)
and nothing else. It is never shipped to an instance as a real database.
